title: Rent status transitions to Maintenance when end date is reached
gherkin:
Feature: End-of-rent lifecycle transition
  Scenario: Rent status transitions to Maintenance upon reaching rental end date
    Given a rent record with status 'Active'
    And the rental end date is set to today
    When the system processes the end-of-rent transition
    Then the rent status shall be updated to 'Maintenance'
    And the rent record shall remain in the system
rationale: This test directly validates the primary requirement that upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'. This is the core behavioral expectation for R25.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
